**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

name: Herschel Walker
subject: the racist attacks just keep coming
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC
body:
Yes, I’m Black and a Republican. That REALLY bothers the Left. |
---

Peter - MSNBC has called me every name in the book during this campaign.

**They've likened me to a slave doing the bidding of my white masters; they've called me a "token" Black Republican.**

After my debate with Senator Warnock, their hosts took to the airwaves to tear me down AGAIN.

**Joy Reid and Alex Wagner on _Alex Wagner Tonight_ agreed with a college professor's editorial that I am just a "warm body that can be used as a pawn." Joy Reid further said I was only useful as a Black candidate because I'm "compliant" enough to vote the way Donald Trump and "White Republicans" tell me to.**

_I'm a proud Black man with conservative values. # **Join us for a GOTV Rally and Canvass next Saturday,
October 29th!**

Please join us _**next Saturday, October 29th, at 10AM**_ in Costa Mesa for a Get Out The Vote (G.O.T.V) Rally and Canvass with OCGOP endorsed candidates running in Huntington Beach and Costa Mesa!

Candidates in attendance will be Scott Baugh for U.S. Congress, Janet Nguyen for State Senate, Diane Dixon for State Assembly, Steven Choi for State Assembly, Pat Bates for County Supervisor, Tony Strickland for Huntington Beach City Council, Pat Burns for Huntington Beach City Council, Casey McKeon for Huntington Beach City Council, Gracey Van Der Mark for Huntington Beach City Council, John Moorlach for Costa Mesa Mayor, John Thomas Patton for Costa Mesa City Council - District 3, Rob Dickson for Costa Mesa City Council - District 5, and other local OCGOP endorsed candidates!

Afterwards we will be canvassing the cities of Costa Mesa and Huntington Beach!

**We will be meeting at Estancia Park at 1900 Adams Ave, Costa Mesa, CA 92626 at 10AM on October 29th.**

subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future.
[View this message in your browser](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zja9r7c5msuuqc53c7ottk675ll6jtm1o9hg3a6g_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t56egn4tblm1on4t1kmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfctlleepr9dbjc4qj6cr0suob8otkmmpn8p3hmepj3cbmmhj3ccli6drm8sth6urt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6cooj1ddk61r62pjksiqr4ptgmlin48d245p25oh4cdhm6pb4cjh6aob24no)
This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvhelqagdhogc7uathhfaobhgcnra7r8qb6mb430_rp22sh2s8i66or3cli69oj5c5h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zpa3e9ncv6fe4jh100n3bts4hfcapaugptb7j500_rp22sh2s8i66or3cli69oj5c5h2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zv2kr0030m9av9svm0rjp9tglkd4t0sd34771l1o_rp22sh2s8i66or3cli69oj5c5h2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

### A Note from Rob Ortt:

Dear Neighbors-
We are down to the wire with 2 weeks to go till election day on November 8th. Every newspaper is reporting what we have known for the past two years: crime and the economy are affecting our lives. Now, more than ever, it is time to get energized. I encourage all of you, if you can and have the time, to join us. We are working hard to elect Lee Zeldin and a slew of Republican Senators around the state. If you want to volunteer please reach out to [info@robortt.com](mailto:info@robortt.com).
Every vote matters this election and with everyone pitching in we will WIN come election day!
-Rob

body:
I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out.

|
---
| | | Friend,

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been reaching out more recently, but that's only because we have less than 21 days until the Election and we desperately need everyone to step up.

**I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I 'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this goal means so much.**

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z165u5j3sm9n7e8erkvl7ba0k514rchjon12jjao_rp22sh2s8i66or3clh66ob4c3h2bs "2")
---
_My parents on their Wedding Day._
This is a photo of my parents on their wedding day. Thankfully, they came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream they came to realize.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2ztru6ed7gf59e633b9hu496er5m4u7iuilnakf9o_rp22sh2s8i66or3clh66ob4c3h2bs "1")
---
_My sister, Veronica, our mother, and me at graduation._
Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette in college and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zhvftuemcivda5qhmg2k87mjnhfhtcvjq8eulgm8_rp22sh2s8i66or3clh66ob4c3h2bs "3")
---
_My wife, Jeanette, my daughter, Amanda, and me, circa 2000._
All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---

---
_Campaigning for president in 2015 with my beautiful family._
After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

_On the campaign trail in August 2022. _
**This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.**
I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these goals may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real.**If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.

Marco Rubio

| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** **** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.
---

---
| | That’s why we need the support of friends like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.
Quantities of this special DVD box set are limited, so reserve your copy today. I’ve included a secure link for you to make your tax-deductible gift below:
[_**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/dvd-mathematics-and-logic-course**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zcft9ac27jqq37l4o8jrp5bu196mbuavapbtmsgg_rp22sh2s8i66or3clh61or4cjh2bs)
Thank you for partnering with Hillsdale in its mission on behalf of liberty.
Warm regards,

| Peter,
I recently joined Tucker Carlson and the buzz around my campaign has continued to gain tremendous momentum. I'm taking time from my busy schedule campaigning to write you this email, so even if you don't send a gift, I'd really appreciate it if you'd read it in its entirety.
**[If you'd like to make a donation to continue my campaign's momentum, you can do so here.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61717816:66SpYgVNz:m:1:3331421248:6F3230CCD9A9449668A44E2521D6006C:r)**
We covered a number of topics that I think every voter in PA should know about.
**The Establishment turning their back on a 30 year Army veteran.** I served our country honorably and led some of the best young men our nation has to offer, yet when I announced for Governor the political Establishment on both sides shunned me... it must mean I'm speaking the hard truths, but as our second President John Adams famously said "facts are stubborn things." The political Establishment in our country is failing Republicans, Democrats, and everyone in between, and I'll never bow to their go-along get-along agenda. They doubted me in the primary, but with the backing of the grassroots and patriots in Pennsylvania and across our country, I proved them wrong, and I'm going to do it again on November 8th.
**Unleashing Pennsylvania 's oil and gas reserves to jumpstart our economy on Day 1 of a Mastriano administration.** The answer to many of our economic woes is unleashing American energy dominance, and as Governor of Pennsylvania, on Day 1, I'll have the power to open up drilling and fracking at a scale never seen before in our nation's history. Joe Biden's war on American energy got us into this mess, and Pennsylvania will be where the American energy comeback begins. | | | | [DONATE](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61717816:66SpYgVNz:m:1:3331421248:6F3230CCD9A9449668A44E2521D6006C:r)

**Josh Shapiro 's record of failure when it comes to violent crime.**

It’s my 18th wedding anniversary, a day that I will never forget. I got to marry the love of my life surrounded by my family and friends. I wanted to share a few photos with you all from that day: When Elizabeth and I were married, I had no idea the life that we would create in Vermont. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53155778/374575349/929104573?refcode=E18949-20221023-Anniversary-graphic-Other-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=27&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMzgxN2ZhMy1kNzUyLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1iCcyjOlO_Ozk-HoxFiKZ06lPUf7vwW5d-jm8TWmQIo=) Our marriage was not a political statement, but as I look back, I can’t help but think how far we’ve come. When we first got married, we had to have the Justice of the Peace perform a civil union because civil marriage for same-sex couples was not yet legal in Vermont. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53155779/374575350/929104573?refcode=E18949-20221023-Anniversary-graphic-Other-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=27&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMzgxN2ZhMy1kNzUyLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1iCcyjOlO_Ozk-HoxFiKZ06lPUf7vwW5d-jm8TWmQIo=) Having a civil union rather than a civil marriage didn’t dampen our joy that day, but it did feel like we were being asked to be content with second-class status. That never sat right with me. And ultimately, my belief that every American deserves dignity and respect, no matter who they love or how they identify, is what drove me to run for public office. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53155780/374575351/929104573?refcode=E18949-20221023-Anniversary-graphic-Other-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=27&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMzgxN2ZhMy1kNzUyLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1iCcyjOlO_Ozk-HoxFiKZ06lPUf7vwW5d-jm8TWmQIo=) As we work to make progress into the future, treating others with kindness, dignity, and respect will always lead us in the right direction. With love, Becca Balint **[DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53155781/374575352/929104573?refcode=E18949-20221023-Anniversary-SB-Other-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=27&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMzgxN2ZhMy1kNzUyLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1iCcyjOlO_Ozk-HoxFiKZ06lPUf7vwW5d-jm8TWmQIo=)**

body:
This is my story

| |
---
| | | Hi, I'm Adam Laxalt, and this is my story.

---
| [](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a479e2625e294796b791ea2675da4783&_e=sn87zSJkv_QoJ38_h0CKhdz6NsZwn_Z3Un7QOG5cenUE7kk3kfobzbsBIWYxSnSKoyvxMBkUuX-5H_lm97Hx9uvlvAwHwysYGK0VQkRUBvqSyrcBgAB_sSXQq670U1IfMYIAmqXXRFcJTV11Dqjchx8ksRJtXuCgUoRJ3_IukyJ1ozEwLLAk0RNnZLvCAEy572DJNjVnkp0CWeXrAW-AzXNgy7_e4fnHoj2Ab9965sI3FcVpQPXORvGFU5Vb2kjz0-GQPpQDg0FnsxKUxvFt-T2H7dBLXWeeBB9CcAfj0snnd3NdIeh7PNPamLrp5sy94EWb_oLFiGGST0pI3WrLRIe745qUEIeGb8FEBmbWlGeeOc-joYyI5lX0UCsgil9QOAXxkMZH7gi7GInpI50BUcPaHpuDjFWqWackHTbTo2M%3D "Adam 1")
---

I didn't know who my father was. I was born to a single mother in the 1970s. She was in her early 20s, had no college degree, and faced enormous pressure to not bring me into this world. But through faith, she chose to give me the chance to live, and I'll be forever grateful for that opportunity.

---
| [](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a479e2625e294796b791ea2675da4783&_e=sn87zSJkv_QoJ38_h0CKhdz6NsZwn_Z3Un7QOG5cenUE7kk3kfobzbsBIWYxSnSKoyvxMBkUuX-5H_lm97Hx9uvlvAwHwysYGK0VQkRUBvqSyrcBgAB_sSXQq670U1IfMYIAmqXXRFcJTV11Dqjchx8ksRJtXuCgUoRJ3_IukyJ1ozEwLLAk0RNnZLvCAEy572DJNjVnkp0CWeXrAW-AzXNgy7_e4fnHoj2Ab9965sI3FcVpQPXORvGFU5Vb2kjz0-GQPpQDg0FnsxKUxvFt-X7UundLYwbQlEEl_w6lOWZB8KboHpkTnLmoHOXNGPj1zp6IcnsGJAjKPPY4ZWvGljFqVo9CFfcruwMuzbPW0rfqQCFkH1uV9mDUVLLBFcidN9-Vl13UggoL35ssbG96psz44JPsKLEdUiS4pE5Gp3g%3D "Adam 2")
---

Although my childhood wasn't always easy, my experiences shaped me into the person I am today. I learned the power of faith and the importance of family and community. Without these things, there is no way I could've accomplished everything that I have.

---
| [](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a479e2625e294796b791ea2675da4783&_e=sn87zSJkv_QoJ38_h0CKhdz6NsZwn_Z3Un7QOG5cenUE7kk3kfobzbsBIWYxSnSKoyvxMBkUuX-5H_lm97Hx9uvlvAwHwysYGK0VQkRUBvqSyrcBgAB_sSXQq670U1IfMYIAmqXXRFcJTV11Dqjchx8ksRJtXuCgUoRJ3_IukyJ1ozEwLLAk0RNnZLvCAEy572DJNjVnkp0CWeXrAW-AzXNgy7_e4fnHoj2Ab9965sI3FcVpQPXORvGFU5Vb2kjz0-GQPpQDg0FnsxKUxvFt-U5TzAy8zHpAzzGkhCPpmGAzXo1Y6Rg4AY9ar5yDFiohtEVWLOs2KOHZpMODvRDaP1vvZ1I2JjLKNNQkcfuhv_QemhDJlYfef4qdud4CEKGYS1atyIPM7Y-nZlb_Q_Lfrj-xTWYdrjFkg0ioU8QyiQA%3D "Adam 3")
---

After 9/11 attacks, I joined the US Navy - I always knew I wanted to serve my country, but after that date, I knew I needed to act. As a Naval Officer and Iraq Veteran, I served in detainee operations and assisted in the detention and prosecution of more than 20,000 detainees.

---
| [](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a479e2625e294796b791ea2675da4783&_e=sn87zSJkv_QoJ38_h0CKhdz6NsZwn_Z3Un7QOG5cenUE7kk3kfobzbsBIWYxSnSKoyvxMBkUuX-5H_lm97Hx9uvlvAwHwysYGK0VQkRUBvqSyrcBgAB_sSXQq670U1IfMYIAmqXXRFcJTV11Dqjchx8ksRJtXuCgUoRJ3_IukyJ1ozEwLLAk0RNnZLvCAEy572DJNjVnkp0CWeXrAW-AzXNgy7_e4fnHoj2Ab9965sI3FcVpQPXORvGFU5Vb2kjz0-GQPpQDg0FnsxKUxvFt-aByH0Z5-t5--YZobHCiTui18qiVooiRSXMAddz9txaDpQBbEzKjuXbNb9lks1UzDdWwJ8YmpSdmwBAjc2QDgbszOr5chCQwhBblm1DHeITrwbBnBYnLl3CcqzuoTRX2R1njS2Ayt4aLZg4-eu764iE%3D "Adam 4")
---

Nothing made me prouder than keeping my fellow Americans safe by assisting with the prosecution of thousands of war criminals and terrorists.

After finishing my active duty service, I decided to get married and start my family. But I knew I wasn't done serving and protecting our country. In 2015, I became Nevada's Attorney General, where I fought against President Obama by suing over federal overreach. I fought for the Constitution.

---

Today I live in Reno with my wife, Jaime, and four kids. They're the reason I'm running for US Senate.

I believe our country is fighting a battle between good and evil, and right now it seems the wrong side is winning. But I believe America is worth saving, and I know you do too.

_**[That's why I'm asking you to join my team and fight with me to restore conservative leadership in Washington.](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a479e2625e294796b791ea2675da4783&_e=sn87zSJkv_QoJ38_h0CKhdz6NsZwn_Z3Un7QOG5cenUE7kk3kfobzbsBIWYxSnSKoyvxMBkUuX-5H_lm97Hx9uvlvAwHwysYGK0VQkRUBvqSyrcBgAB_sSXQq670U1IfMYIAmqXXRFcJTV11Dqjchx8ksRJtXuCgUoRJ3_IukyJ1ozEwLLAk0RNnZLvCAEy572DJNjVnkp0CWeXrAW-AzXNgy7_e4fnHoj2Ab9965sI3FcVpQPXORvGFU5Vb2kjz0-GQPpQDg0FnsxKUxvFt-Yxwvx9O8OuDJkjzfBXem7C3FuL4LZTnMoVhAPB3KecIpopdmWfdiJM2WG9r-xzPa5rXMg3g_xl5mS87H6wcSyrBHW785AR4_xkfz1UXppjpML8CBo-ndMEi3G6wDiJXh_wlmqhDkanFilTwbLZ9Ftw%3D "That’s why I’m asking you to join my team and fight with me to restore conservative leadership in Washington.")**_ Together we can take this country back, but we must act now. Mike Lee

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

name: Great America Update
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6431%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=d9AXAB%2fhDyNkq1z0b02RvQ&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from Great America Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c77604%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=gCz3f81ySFvCjhWN84vKdA&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c77615%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=gaNkOTYlBNPqrZah28%2bOvQ&sysid=1)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c77615%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=gaNkOTYlBNPqrZah28%2bOvQ&sysid=1)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

In order to turn out a historic number of voters on Election Day, we need all hands on deck.
#
Right now, we’re building one of the biggest organizing programs Texas has ever seen so we can make history and elect Beto as our next Governor.

Team Beto volunteers have already accomplished some amazing things. **But in order to turn out a historic number of voters on Election Day, we need all hands on deck.**

We’re reaching out to you because our campaign needs your help to make direct, personal contact with as many Texans as we can.
[**Will you sign up today for a virtual webinar for out-of-state Team Beto volunteers?**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/57318?t=1&akid=213611%2E444211%2ElhIsUS) We'll talk about how you can make the biggest impact, and you’ll have the chance to connect with fellow supporters.
**[Sign Up »](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/57318?t=2&akid=213611%2E444211%2ElhIsUS)**
Winning in Texas won't be easy, especially with the extreme voter suppression happening right in front of our eyes. But we know that we're capable of generating historic voter turnout and electing Beto, if we put in the work right now.
Thank you for being part of this,
Katherine Fischer
Organizing Director, Beto for Texas

| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid. While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law. Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father's cabin, and did not return until he could "give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight." By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun. That's why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **" Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry." ** Through** "Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,"** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsYWLTShoN

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only
take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our
nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives-but
supported by many well-meaning Americans-to change the way we
elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the
Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osYWLTShoN

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent
matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but
the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by
progressives-but supported by many well-meaning Americans-to
change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do
away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our
Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a
National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to
me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more
clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning
this issue-views we will make available to policymakers and
opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on
Presidential Selection by using the link below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60971936:sYWLTShoN:m:3:2532013465:3E3101D74BC628BB5BF1545ECA013504:r

For most of our nation's history, the
Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution,
was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to
preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have
joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional
bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution
has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to
provide young people with a proper grounding in American
civics-too many Americans simply don't understand the importance
of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has
expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide,
directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the
Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide
through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The
Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over 5.6 million households and
businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of
liberty;

Promoting constitutional education
through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of
America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across
America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education
through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which
launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools
nationwide.

Your answers to the National Survey on
Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most
effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the
importance of the Constitution to liberty-including the
importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this
critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent
topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection
and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a
few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure
link I've provided below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60971936:sYWLTShoN:m:3:2532013465:3E3101D74BC628BB5BF1545ECA013504:r

And after you take your survey, I hope you
will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a
tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing
truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its
extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept
ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form
of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is
essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the
National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for
your time and attention-and for your friendship and support of
liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since
1844

clean_body: Support my campaign and the DNC to continue the fight to protect our fundamental freedoms and help elect Democrats nationwide. | | "Get over it." That's what my Republican opponent said about attacks on abortion rights. Here's what I have to say to that: We won't "get over it." Instead, we're going to show anti-choice Republicans what happens when you try to take away our fundamental rights. But with Election Day right around the corner, we’ve got to pick up the pace. There are only 16 days left to help protect this seat -- and I need you by my side in this fight. You haven’t yet split a donation between my campaign and the DNC, so I need your support. Chip in $10 or whatever you can to support my reelection campaign and the DNC. Your contribution will help elect Democrats nationwide. I'm no stranger to tough campaigns. I've lost races before -- and I've won by the smallest of margins. When I won my Senate seat in 2016, it was by a 1,017 vote margin. Yes, you read that right: Only 1,017. That small vote margin is also part of why Republicans think they can take my seat this November. The Senate is split 50-50, and the GOP sees New Hampshire as one of their best chances at regaining the majority. That's why they're throwing everything they have my way. Thank you so much for your support, Maggie Sen. I say what I’m going to do, and then I deliver. It’s what I’ve been doing my entire career because I care about the people I represent—whether they’re Democrats, Republicans, or don’t vote at all.

* While JD was writing a book blaming the working class for their economic struggles, _I was working to make sure Ohio kids had access to healthy food._

* While JD was in San Francisco enjoying “tasty brunches, day trips to wine country, and art gallery tours,” _I was fighting to protect workers’ pensions._

Yes, the prospect of Don Bolduc as a U.S. Senator is terrifying, but the truth is we are more hopeful than ever. That’s thanks, in no small part, to the outpouring of support from people like you, for champions like Maggie Hassan.

So please, join us in turning rage into hope.
Your voice matters,
– Mandy Patinkin & Kathryn Grody

My road to this moment was not easy.
| | |
---
Friend: Each and every day, it is not lost on me that I'm in what will undoubtedly be the most expensive race for the U.S. Senate in 2022 – a race that could decide the Senate majority and will be anything but easy.
But I know a thing or two about persevering, and _winning_ , even when the odds are stacked against me.
I've overcome plenty of adversity in my life, friend. **There is nothing easy about growing up as a poor Black girl in the segregated South.** But my family's faith, and faith in opportunity, taught me perseverance. It was my family, particularly my mother's words of "never tire of doing good, Val," that pushed me to where I am today.
I carry the spirit of her words with me even still – as I reflect on my career of service to Floridians and my path to being a candidate for U.S. Senate.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53149937/374552592/2061369689?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4961-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NmM4YzQzNS1jYTUyLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MGRosDBRlhXTfbb1WOlJDetbUdvvq7uinQsfKIF6VlY=)
**There was nothing easy about being a first-generation college graduate** – nor was it easy working my way up the ranks of the Orlando Police Department. For 27 years, I served when it wasn't exactly ordinary to see a woman on the force, let alone a Black woman. But I never tired, and eventually, I became the first woman to lead my department as chief of police.
And friend, I know firsthand that there's nothing easy about winning elections in Florida. My first run for Congress was one of my toughest fights – but even in defeat I never tired, because I knew I could do good for my community. And it certainly wasn't easy to hold a lawless president – a habitual offender – to account. But I served as an impeachment manager, prosecuting Donald Trump in the Senate, because no one should be above the law.
My road to this moment was not easy. But I'm not sure that there’s anywhere except America where a little Black girl – the daughter of a maid and a janitor who grew up in the '60s South – could have a story so filled with opportunities like these. And I am determined to meet this moment, win and never tire of doing good so that anyone can have a story of opportunity.
This may be my toughest challenge yet, which is why I'm urging you – every last person reading this email – to chip in whatever you can to ensure I have the resources to defeat Marco Rubio and win in Florida: [**Please, will you give $5 or more to help me flip Florida blue and defend our Democratic Senate majority? With so much gratitude for all you do,

Val Demings

If you look in your inbox, you'll probably find an email from our campaign asking you to volunteer. If you've been a part of this team for a while, you'll probably find quite a few!
**That's because our plan to win hinges on building the largest organizing program in Texas history.** We've done our research, and the data shows if our volunteer movement can connect with millions of voters before Election Day, we will win.
But here's the catch, every organizing email we send replaces a fundraising email we _could_ be sending. It's a trade-off that leads to less revenue. It's why most campaigns wouldn't even consider sending as many organizing emails as we do — but we know it’s a risk worth taking.
We can do this because we trust that this people-powered team will step up with donations — and this is one of those moments. **If we're going to fund our Get Out The Vote efforts before Election Day, we need the resources to close the gap in our budget shortfall.**

Peter, as an Army veteran, family man, and Republican running in the most competitive swing state in America, I don't normally have time to send out messages like this one. But this is an **ELECTION EMERGENCY!**
The future of the United States depends on the outcome of the midterm election and the nationwide response to this email today will change the entire trajectory.
Barack Obama, Bernie Sanders, Kamala Harris AND Joe Biden are all launching campaign tours in swing states to mobilize Liberals to the polls and rake in TONS of last-minute cash. **Mark my words: If they flip even a few hundred votes in these states, we WILL lose the 2022 election.**
[**There 's only one way to prevent a devastating election defeat: we need AT LEAST 10,000 Conservative donors to step up before midnight tonight. Any less than that and we'll be forced to pull down our Get-Out-The-Vote ads and slash the budgets for our voter contact operations in the final weeks of the election!**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61718277:Jj0ilgVFN:m:1:3331703221:B12342FFF8A2AEF4B1947C3F0914D819:r)

I served tours in Iraq, became an Apache pilot, and built a life for my God-loving family in the heart of Michigan. As a Black Republican, I represent EVERYTHING the Democrats fear the most.
_That 's why they're outraising, outspending, and running a nationwide ad blitz to spread Liberal propaganda and tarnish campaigns like mine._
[**The truth is, the best thing you can do today to help save America from Radical Leftists is to rush support to vulnerable Republicans (like me). Not tomorrow, TODAY.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61718277:Jj0ilgVFN:m:1:3331703221:B12342FFF8A2AEF4B1947C3F0914D819:r)
**[CHIP IN ANY AMOUNT BEFORE MIDNIGHT ->](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61718278:Jj0ilgVFN:m:1:3331703221:B12342FFF8A2AEF4B1947C3F0914D819:r)**
Thank you for your support,
John James
* * *
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61718281:Jj0ilgVFN:m:1:3331703221:B12342FFF8A2AEF4B1947C3F0914D819:r)
Can you keep this between us? Pollsters, pundits, and the media are saying the unthinkable -- _Pelosi and the Democrats have a chance to defeat us. And with hundreds of millions of dollars in their war chest to spend attacking us -- they 're going ALL IN._
We'll say it straight: we're being outraised. And if we sit here and do nothing, Pelosi and the Democrats will buy this election from under us. [**If you 've been waiting to step up, now is the time. Everything President Trump worked so hard to build -- our Conservative Supreme Court Majority, a secure border, a booming economy, HIS ENTIRE LEGACY -- is on the line.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61718281:Jj0ilgVFN:m:1:3331703221:B12342FFF8A2AEF4B1947C3F0914D819:r)

name: Team Jazz
subject: Equity, opportunity for all
body:
Look, Jazz has dedicated his life to the fight for social justice, not cultivating relationships with billionaires.

That’s why we’re asking you to chip in whatever you can right now to help Jazz meet tonight’s filing deadline goal before it’s too late. Will you give what you can to help us raise the last $307 Jazz needs to get there? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lewis_2022email?refcode=Octemail]

DONATE NOW » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lewis_2022email?refcode=Octemails]

Jazz’s work in the Maryland House of Delegates is changing lives. He’s doing the real work to build a more just and equitable society. That means taking on entrenched systems of power to reform our unjust and often predatory criminal justice system, achieve health care equity, and level the economic playing field for communities of color.

Jazz is more than ready to keep fighting for our families, but he needs us to work together now to keep his campaign going in these critical final weeks.

Please, will you rush whatever you can to help Jazz meet his filing deadline goal by midnight? He is still $307 short, and he’s counting on grassroots supporters to close the gap. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lewis_2022email?refcode=Octemails]

-- Team Jazz

As a proven progressive leader and champion of issues ranging from criminal justice reform to healthcare access and economic equity, Jazz has represented the 24th Legislative District in Maryland’s House of Delegates since 2017. He also serves as Chair of the Maryland House Democratic Caucus. A lifelong Prince Georgian, Jazz lives in Glenarden with his wife and son.

subject: I’m reaching out today because John needs our support.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Texans for John Lira
body:
Team —

I’m reaching out today to ask you to support my husband, John, so he can flip TX-23. Please, give me a chance to explain why this is so important. (If you don’t need an explanation, click here to rush a contribution now!) [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-lira?refcode=EM_FR_221007michelle_EOM_TL_FL_10_NG_N_logo&amount=3]

I’ve watched John on the campaign trail for a year now. And it hasn’t always been easy. His opponent has a ton of money and could drop millions in attack ads against him at any moment.

But John has never let that scare him. In fact, it makes him push even harder. And with just a few weeks until Election Day — he is going nonstop.
It’s clear that TX-23 deserves a true representative in Washington. So, how can you help?

John needs to be prepared for any attacks that come against him this month, and the best way to do that is to make sure he hits his fundraising goal before tomorrow at midnight. We can’t afford to fall short. So, what do you say?

If you are able, will you make a $3 donation to John’s campaign? We need everyone to chip in if we are going to reach our next goal in time. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-lira?refcode=EM_FR_221007michelle_EOM_TL_FL_10_NG_N_logo&amount=25]

Thank you so much,

Michelle

We know that when we vote, we win.
#
Derek,
We’re in the home stretch of this race and it’s crucial that we keep up our momentum to elect John to the U.S. Senate.
**The truth is, Derek, this race is a tossup and anything could happen.** Our opponent Dr. Oz has a net worth of MILLION$ + the support of dark money PACs and GOP leaders — and they will stop at _nothing_ to continue spreading lies about John and our campaign.
The only sure-fire way to fight back is by harnessing the power of our grassroots movement over these next 17 days and continuing to get our message in front of as many Pennsylvania voters as possible.
**[That’s why we’re calling on you to support our campaign today, Derek. Will you help us ramp up our fundraising and push our campaign to the finish line with a donation of $5 or more?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221023-1?refcode=em20221023-7846&refcode2=7846_434096_qCrSTc&akid=7846%2E434096%2EqCrSTc)**
**[Donate Now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221023-1?refcode=em20221023-7846&refcode2=7846_434096_qCrSTc&akid=7846%2E434096%2EqCrSTc)**
Now more than ever, we need to ensure that we have the tools and resources to keep up our robust GOTV plan and reach as many PA voters as possible. Because we know that when we vote, we win.
We need to be prepared to take on anything our opposition throws our way. That starts by recruiting as many volunteers as possible to cover enough ground in Pennsylvania. We need clipboards, yard signs, pens, flyers, TV and radio ads, and so much more to ensure that our message won’t get drowned out by Oz and his allies.
**[With just 17 days left, we need to do everything we can to keep up our movement’s power. So please, Derek, help fuel our path to victory by chipping in $5 or anything you can afford to our campaign today.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221023-1?refcode=em20221023-7846&refcode2=7846_434096_qCrSTc&akid=7846%2E434096%2EqCrSTc)**

Thank you for believing in our movement.
Together,
Team Fetterman

When we’re this close to Election Day, everything comes down to the numbers. Let’s take a look:
**$31 million**
That’s how much has been poured into this race – _making it one of the most expensive House races in the country._
**50/50**
And it’s with good reason that this race is so expensive! National forecasters have said that Susie Lee’s race is the most competitive in the country, too, and there isn’t an election analyst out there who thinks our odds are any better than a “pure toss-up.”
**$14 million**
And with more than $14 million spent relentlessly attacking Susie – and only more to come from GOP super-PACs in the next two weeks – our team is facing an uphill battle to set the record straight on who in this race is really looking out for Nevadans.
**16 days**
But look, the numbers that matter most are the results on Election Day. That’s why we have to spend every second of the next 16 days talking with voters about the stakes of this race.

Today, we have the advantage of both and its implications are far-reaching indeed.Here's an article by Johnston Meadows that you simply must read: <https://www.idahotribune.org/news/the-numbers-the-false-myth-that-voting-for-ammon-bundy-would-split-the-vote-republicans-gained-150000-voters-since-2018-democrats-gained-only-30000-voters>
# The Numbers: The False Narrative that Voting for Ammon Bundy Would "Split the Vote" -- Republicans Gained 150,000 Voters Since 2018, Democrats Gained Only 30,000 Voters
[](https://www.idahotribune.org/news/the-numbers-the-false-myth-that-voting-for-ammon-bundy-would-split-the-vote-republicans-gained-150000-voters-since-2018-democrats-gained-only-30000-voters)
It has been the perpetual lie of the Republican Establishment that we must pinch our noses and vote for candidates who do not share our values or beliefs, who do not love the Constitution, and who break or destroy our freedoms at the slightest temptation of political advantage or federal money.Meadows' analysis proves beyond that shadow of a doubt that a vote for me will NOT be lost or wasted. That voting for me does not risk splitting the vote or potentially making Idaho suffer under a Democrat as governor, that it is simply not numerically feasible. You may not realize, but over _80% of Idahoans are or lean_ _Conservative_. **No matter how Little and I "split" the vote, it will be either him or me that is our next governor. This is just the facts.** We believe from the feedback we receive everywhere that many Idahoans already believe that I should win. They fear the question of whether or not I can win. I want to address that.Once you put aside the false threat of splitting the vote and embrace the crystal clear fact that I can win, _ask yourself, who do you WANT to win?_ You know where I stand, I have made it as clear as one possibly can, that I will govern solely FOR you and your family. You know that I share your true conservative values to my core.It is with that mission, to protect Idaho from the great threat of anti-Constitutional leadership, that I boldly request all the support you can give me. Your vote in November. Your volunteer efforts. Your social media postings. Your conversations with friends and family. And yes, where you can afford it, your contributions as well.Please go to [votebundy.com](https://votebundy.com/) to support our efforts to clean the house of government and bring Idaho to its full potential! Thank you for your consideration,
Sincerely Yours,Ammon Bundy

We believe from the feedback we receive everywhere that many Idahoans already believe that I should win. They fear the question of whether or not I can win. I want to address that.Once you put aside the false threat of splitting the vote and embrace the crystal clear fact that I can win, ask yourself, who do you WANT to win? You know where I stand, I have made it as clear as one possibly can, that I will govern solely FOR you and your family. You know that I share your true conservative values to my core.It is with that mission, to protect Idaho from the great threat of anti-Constitutional leadership, that I boldly request all the support you can give me. Your vote in November. Your volunteer efforts. Your social media postings. Your conversations with friends and family. And yes, where you can afford it, your contributions as well.Please go to to support our efforts to clean the house of government and bring Idaho to its full potential! | Good morning, friend. I hope you're enjoying the weekend.

Today, Team Asif staff and volunteers are working extremely hard – going door to door across the district to make sure our supporters have the information they need to submit their votes.

Speaking of which, you have 16 days to get your ballot filled out and mailed back. If you haven't yet, please do so today!

When I debrief with my team about what issues are coming up with voters on their doorsteps, one that always sticks out is just how extreme Young Kim's positions are on choice and reproductive rights. This is a fairly moderate district, but that hasn't stopped Kim from touting a harsh, anti-choice platform.

Young Kim and I were recently asked by the _Orange County Register_ to submit a questionnaire outlining our positions. Keep in mind they asked for prepared responses, and Kim still doubled down on being anti-choice. **She even refused to answer whether or not she supports exceptions in the instance of rape or incest.**

So today, I want to be crystal clear on an issue Kim has been so dodgy about. I support reproductive freedom for all Americans. In my work as a physician, I have seen just how personal these decisions are, and I think it’s wrong that politicians would insert themselves.

Your support can still go a long way for our campaign: \- Funding postage and printing costs for last-minute mailers to undecided voters
\- Expanding our TV budget to counter Young Kim's attacks against us.
\- Feeding volunteers and paying for gas to help our team knock doors. If you can, please send in a donation of $3 to power us through Election Day. Your contributions are more urgent now than at any other point in the campaign, so I hope you can chip in today.

clean_body: We’re running out time to show up strong before November 8th. = = October's almost over, and so much has happened that it’s hard to keep track of where things stand. So before I ask you for your hard-earned dollars, I want to lay out the stakes for you. Across our country, Congressional Republicans are clear in their intentions to not only go against everything we stand for, but undo all of the progress Democrats have made these past 2 years. Kevin McCarthy has already outlined the GOP’s game plan if they succeed in a Republican takeover of Congress. On the chopping block? Women’s access to reproductive healthcare, expansions for Medicaid for so many Americans, and even slashes to our Social Security and Medicare programs. These Republicans are not acting like a wolf in sheep’s clothing. They’re saying it loudly for all to hear. We need to do everything we can to ensure Democrats keep our majority in the House so our country doesn’t slip backwards. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | ****=** ** ** | | **=** | **=** ** ** | | **=** | **=** ** ** | | **=** We need to make sure we do all we can to motivate Democrats to turn out this November. We all know what’s at stake – and we can’t afford to get complacent as Democrats. We need to work like everything is on the line – because it is. And Republicans aren’t going down without a fight. Their national campaign arm is raking in money to boost their candidates, and the GOP’s top leaders, like Kevin McCarthy, are being deployed to districts everywhere, trying to mobilize their base to flip seats red and destroy our majority. They’re even competing in seats where President Biden won by double digits. We don’t have to match them dollar for dollar, team, but we do have to up our ground game to make sure we can counter their efforts every step of the way. = = We’re not backing down, Lisa Congresswoman Lisa Blunt Rochester is a Democrat representing the First State, Delaware. name: Richard Blumenthal
subject: Allow me to explain, Friend
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blumenthal for Connecticut
body:
[](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=LpqurBab5I1RlxZ%2B%2FWxl%2BAE%2BQH5l1gUH&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F)
Nate Silver just wrote that the Senate races are tightening across the map - yet as **I write to you, we 're still shy of our must-hit donation goal, and our next big deadline is at midnight.**
I need to explain to you why this cannot happen - and why I'm counting on your donation to get us back on track.
But before I do that, I want to express how deeply appreciative I am to have you on my grassroots team. Our fight to protect this seat and control of the Senate is powered by people like _you_ , Friend. People who are committed to fighting back against Trump, McConnell, and GOP extremists everywhere - and who contribute their time and talent to protect every Democratic seat.
The stakes for this midterm election are probably higher than any in modern history. Senate control is split right down the middle, which means there is _no_ room for error. If we lose a single seat, Mitch McConnell will once again call the shots. Enabling his party's stated plan for a national abortion ban, enacting further limitations on voting rights, nominating and confirming more unqualified and extremist judges to our courts, and shielding Donald Trump from an accountability for his many attempts to undermine the rule of law and our democracy.
My seat has become a GOP target. The National Republican Senatorial Committee is trying to flip this seat, and a right-wing super PAC aligned with my opponent is now spending big on misleading TV ads attacking me. Donald Trump has even been fundraising with my opponent at Mar-a-Lago to try to boost her campaign.
With all we're up against, we cannot fall short on resources to defend this seat - and it's YOUR donation that will put us in the strongest possible position to win.
**It 's your donation, Friend, that could prevent us from a fundraising shortfall, that will ensure we have the resources to combat GOP attacks, and that will help us protect and EXPAND Democratic Senate control.**
**But it needs to happen before our midnight deadline.**
**[So please, will you donate $5 or more to protect this Democratic Senate seat and ensure control of the Senate stays out of the hands of Mitch McConnell?**](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1279-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)
Thank you,
Dick

DELAWARE SUPREME COURT KILLS VOTE-BY-MAIL, SAME-DAY VOTER REGISTRATION

We can claim a victory for cleaner elections in Delaware.

The Delaware Supreme Court struck down
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60739&L=28300&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2FsYmVuY2Utdi1oaWdnaW4tZXQtYWwtbW90aW9uLTM0MjIwMjIvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]
the state’s vote-by-mail and same-day voter registration statutes
for violating the Delaware Constitution. The court effectively concurs
with the _amicus curiae_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60739&L=28301&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2FsYmVuY2Utdi1oaWdnaW4tZXQtYWwtZGUtdm90ZS1ieS1tYWlsLWFtaWN1cy0zNDIyMDIyLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]
brief we submitted in the case, which argues the Delaware statute
impermissibly expands those practices far beyond the limits set in the
Delaware Constitution.

The DATE decision
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60739&L=28300&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2FsYmVuY2Utdi1oaWdnaW4tZXQtYWwtbW90aW9uLTM0MjIwMjIvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]
comes in the case _Albence v Higgin et al._ (DE Vote by Mail
342,2022), in which the court considered the constitutionality of two
state laws passed by the Delaware General Assembly that attempted to
grant every voter the opportunity to vote by mail and register to vote
up to the day of the general election. The court ruled
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60739&L=28302&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2FsYmVuY2Utdi1oaWdnaW4tZXQtYWwtZGUtdm90ZS1ieS1tYWlsLW9yZGVyLTM0MjIwMjIvXTo/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE

> The Vote-by-Mail Statute impermissibly expands the categories of
> absentee voters identified in Article V, Section 4A of the Delaware
> Constitution...The Same-Day Registration Statute conflicts with the
> provisions of Article V, Section 4 of the Delaware
> Constitution...The Court enters this abbreviated order in
> recognition of the impending election scheduled for November 8,
> 2022, and the Department of Election’s desire to mail ballots to
> voters by or around October 10, 2022. A more formal opinion, fully
> explaining the Court’s views and the reasons supporting our
> unanimous decision, will issue in due course. The mandate shall
> issue immediately.
In our _amicus curiae brief_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60739&L=28301&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2FsYmVuY2Utdi1oaWdnaW4tZXQtYWwtZGUtdm90ZS1ieS1tYWlsLWFtaWN1cy0zNDIyMDIyLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=],
we emphasized that mail-in voting is “highly susceptible to fraud
and abuse” and told the court the statute in question is
unconstitutional and should be struck down:

> State and federal officials have universally acknowledged
>
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60739&L=28304&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2FsYmVuY2Utdi1oaWdnaW4tZXQtYWwtZGUtdm90ZS1ieS1tYWlsLWFtaWN1cy0zNDIyMDIyLXBnLTcvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]
> the existence of the threat of fraud due to mail-in voting...Voting
> by mail is ... problematic enough that election experts say there
> have been multiple elections in which no one can say with confidence
> which candidate was the deserved winner.”

***

> The Delaware Constitution and precedent allow
>
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60739&L=28305&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2FsYmVuY2Utdi1oaWdnaW4tZXQtYWwtZGUtdm90ZS1ieS1tYWlsLWFtaWN1cy0zNDIyMDIyLXBnLTkvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]
> absentee and mail-in voting in only the following instances: when in
> public service to the United States or the State of Delaware, due to
> illness or disability, by reason of absence while on vacation, due
> to religious tenets or teachings, and due to emergency declaration
> by the General Assembly in response to an ongoing pandemic...Without
> amending the Delaware Constitution, any legislative act by the
> General Assembly to expand absentee voting beyond these requirements
> is per se invalid.
The court’s ruling makes it harder to unlawfully tamper with an
election. We are gratified that the court agreed with our _amicus_
brief and acted swiftly to strike down these unconstitutional election
laws that created increased opportunities for fraud in the November 8
elections.

disconcerting that our Centers for Disease Control has been less than
forthcoming about what it knew and when.

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60739&L=28290&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2NhdGVnb3JpZXMvY292aWQtYWR2ZXJzZS1lZmZlY3RzLXBhcnRzLTEtMi8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE]

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60739&L=27179&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvdmFjY2luZS1zaWRlLWVmZmVjdHMvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]
against HHS
(_Judicial Watch v. U.S. Department of Health and Human Services_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60739&L=26977&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtaGhzLXZhY2NpbmUtYWR2aXNvcnktY29tbWl0dGVlLWNvbXBsYWludC0wMDY2MC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE]

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60739&L=28292&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY2RjLmdvdi9uY2JkZGQvYWJvdXR1cy9iaW9ncmFwaGllcy9jb2huLmh0bWw/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE],

FDA Director of the Center for Biologics Evaluation and Research
(CBER) Dr. Peter Marks
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60739&L=27732&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmRhLmdvdi9hYm91dC1mZGEvZmRhLW9yZ2FuaXphdGlvbi9wZXRlci1tYXJrcz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]
and other
officials about COVID-19 vaccines: “I have another issue to discuss
as well, reports of myocarditis in adolescents. I am putting together
an email, but this may come to the surface this weekend.”

In a section of an FDA briefing document
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60739&L=28294&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtaGhzLWNvdmlkLXZheC1hZHZlcnNlLWV2ZW50cy1wcm9kLTEtMDA2NjAtcGFydHMtMS0yLXBncy00MS0xMDQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]
submitted by Johnson & Johnson/Janssen to the FDA regarding trials of
its COVID vaccine, J&J notes that five people experienced serious
adverse events: “selected events among vaccine recipients for which
a contributory effect of the vaccine could not be excluded based on
FDA assessment of the clinical information provided.”

These adverse events included deep vein thromboses, pulmonary
embolism, transverse sinus thrombosis, seizure and hemiparesis
(inability to move
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60739&L=28295&F=T&]
one side of the body) occurring anywhere from three to 28 days
following vaccination.

In a section of the same briefing document as above, titled
“Pregnancies,” the briefing document notes that of four women who
became pregnant following the Janssen shot, two of the babies were
lost – one due to an ectopic pregnancy and the other due to
“spontaneous abortion.”

In a section of the document titled “Safety Summary,” the study
states: “Numerical imbalances were reported between vaccine and
placebo recipients for thromboembolic events (15 versus 10) and
tinnitus (6 versus 0).”

It beggars belief that the Biden administration tried to hide these
key documents that would serve to inform the public about the safety
of the COVID vaccines.
