clean_body: Covid Vaccine Secrets! [INSIDE JW] Judicial Watch Sues Secret Service for Records about Raid on Trump’s Home [=] Given that the Secret Service is charged with protecting former President Trump and his home, it’s critical that we know what it knew when Biden’s FBI stormed into Trump’s Florida estate. We filed a FOIA lawsuit against the Department of Homeland Security for all communications of the U.S. Secret Service internally and with the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) regarding the raid on President Trump’s home and for any video or audio recordings made during the raid on August 8, 2022 (Judicial Watch Inc. v. U.S Department of Homeland Security [== (No. 1:22-cv-03147)). We sued in the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia after the Secret Service ignored an August 11, 2022, FOIA request asking for: All emails and text messages between officials in the Office of the USSS Director and officials of the Federal Bureau of Investigation regarding the search warrant and/or execution of the search warrant on former President Trump’s home on or about August 8, 2022. All emails and text messages sent to and from officials on President Trump’s USSS protective detail regarding the search warrant and/or execution of the search warrant on President Trump’s residence on or about August 8, 2022. All video and audio recordings capturing the execution of the search warrant on President Trump’s home on August 8, 2022. The FBI reportedly [=] notified the Secret Service a few hours before the raid that it would happen and that Secret Service agents facilitated access to Trump’s home. What is the Secret Service trying to hide about its involvement in the Biden FBI’s unprecedented and abusive raid of Trump’s home. This FOIA lawsuit, the fourth we’ve filed on the Trump raid, further highlights the Biden administration’s comprehensive cover-up about its latest abuses of the former president. We are in the forefront on the court battle for transparency regarding the raid. Last week, we announced [] that the National Archives is withholding 99% of the requested records about the raid in response to Judicial Watch’s FOIA lawsuit. In August, we forced the release [==] of the raid affidavit through a court request [=] to unseal the warrant materials used in the raid. We also filed two lawsuits [==] against the Justice Department for records of the raid search warrant application and approval, as well as communications about the warrant between the FBI, the Executive Office of the President, and the Secret Service. More is coming... FDA RECORDS DETAIL PRESSURE ON COVID BOOSTER USE AND APPROVAL We received 43 pages [] of heavily redacted records from the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regarding the COVID-19 booster vaccine. We obtained the records in response to a February 2022 FOIA lawsuit [] against the Department of Health & Human Services (HHS) we filed after HHS failed to respond to a September 3, 2021, FOIA request for records of communication from the former director and deputy director of the FDA’s Office of Vaccines Research and Review, Dr. Marion Gruber and Dr. Philip Krause, (Judicial Watch v. U.S. Department of Health and Human Services [= (No. 1:22-cv-00293)). On September 13, 2021, Gruber and Krause [==] were among a group of resigning [==] doctors who agreed that, “Available evidence doesn’t yet indicate a need for COVID-19 vaccine booster shots among the general population ...” In a July 13, 2021, email [=] to an individual whose name is redacted, Beatrice Kalungall, a Branch Chief in the FDA’s Center for Biologics Evaluation and Research (CBER)/ Office of Tissues and Advanced Therapies, provided a list of responses to questions posed about “Use of Covid-19 Vaccines in Research.” One of the questions asked was, “Are the EUA vaccines [Emergency Use Authorization Covid-19 vaccines] considered ‘lawfully marketed’ (21 CFR 312.2(b)) for the purposes of an IND [Investigational New Drug] exemption (though we anticipate it is likely that we would still file an IND based on other criteria)?” Kalungall replied: “Vaccines which are available under EUA may be considered ‘lawfully marketed’ if used under the scope of authorization as described in the Letter of Authorization (LOA) for each product. Note that an important consideration is the possible risk to subjects so please clearly identify the intended study population and include a discussion of the issue from your perspective.” In a separate email [==] thread and discussion generated from the same initiating July 13, 2021, email regarding “Use of Covid-19 Vaccines in Research”, Dr. Doran Fink, a top official in the Office of Vaccines Research and Review, writes: “Providers are losing confidence in FDA/CDC to do the right thing for their patients, including that we can’t give inquiring patients a straight answer about what they are allowed to do outside of an IND [Investigational New Drug].” Dr. Krause, Deputy Director of the FDA’s Office of Vaccines Research and Review, responds to Fink: “From my brief discussion with Peter [presumably, CBER Director Peter Marks] this morning, after some calls with CDC and HHS last night, the problem is that the [redacted]. Take a deep breath before reading this next paragraph. On that call, the CDC evidently stated that they will assemble all the data they are aware of on third dosing in this setting, and send it to us in the hope that we will (very soon) authorize the third dose for immunocompromised as part of the EUA. Peter told me that CBER IOD [presumably CBER Immediate Office of the Director] will triage this—I told him I need to be cc:ed on any of these communications so we don’t get blindsided, but that we also need to protect the review team.” These FDA records further document top officials’ concerns about the controversial COVID-19 booster shots. That it has taken months and a federal lawsuit to uncover this critical material is a scandal. In a previous production from the February 2022 FOIA lawsuit, Judicial Watch received 112 pages [=] from the FDA that show top officials being pressured by companies and the Biden administration to impose timelines on approval for the booster shots “that make no sense.” Through FOIA, we have uncovered a substantial amount of information about COVID-19 issues: Recently, we revealed HHS records that detail [] the extensive plans for a propaganda campaign to push the COVID-19 vaccine. We uncovered NIH records [=] revealing an FBI “inquiry” into the NIH’s controversial bat coronavirus grant tied to the Wuhan Institute of Virology. The records also show National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID) officials were concerned about “gain-of-function” research in China’s Wuhan Institute of Virology in 2016. The Fauci agency was also concerned about EcoHealth Alliance’s [=] lack of compliance with reporting rules and use of gain-of-function research in the NIH-funded research involving bat coronaviruses in Wuhan, China. Department of Veterans Affairs records [==] detailed the adverse reactions of veterans to the COVID-19 vaccines. As of April 2021, Veteran’s Health Services reported 895 serious reactions which included: 20 cardiac arrests, 36 strokes, 15 cases of deep vein thrombosis, 10 heart attacks, and 19 pulmonary embolisms. They also reported over 26,000 less serious reactions. The agency withheld [] individual report details asserting privacy exemptions under FOIA. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention records [==] show Director Rochelle Walensky’s communications, include a request for details about the death of a teenager who died days after receiving a coronavirus vaccination. The records also include a study paid for and conducted by Pfizer and BioNTech that found [== Adverse event analyses during the blinded period are provided for 43,847 ≥16-year-olds (Table S3). Reactogenicity events among participants not in the reactogenicity subset are reported as adverse events, resulting in imbalances in adverse events (30% vs 14%), related adverse events (24% vs 6%), and severe adverse events (1.2% vs 0.7%) between BNT162b2 and placebo groups. Decreased appetite, lethargy, asthenia, malaise, night sweats, and hyperhidrosis were new adverse events attributable to BNT162b2 not previously identified in earlier reports. HHS records reveal that from 2014 to 2019, $826,277 [] was given to the Wuhan Institute of Virology for bat coronavirus research by the NIAID. NIAID records show that it gave nine China-related grants to EcoHealth Alliance [] to research coronavirus emergence in bats and was the NIH’s top issuer of grants to the Wuhan lab itself. The records also include an email from the vice director of the Wuhan Lab asking an NIH official for help finding disinfectants for decontamination of airtight suits and indoor surfaces. HHS records include an “urgent for Dr. Fauci [] ” email chain, citing ties between the Wuhan lab and the taxpayer-funded EcoHealth Alliance [=]. The government emails also reported that U.S. billionaire Bill Gates’s foundation worked closely with the Chinese government to pave the way for Chinese-produced medications to be sold outside China and help “raise China’s voice of governance by placing representatives from China on important international counsels as high level commitment from China.” HHS records include a grant application for research involving the coronavirus that appears to describe “gain-of-function [= research involving RNA extractions from bats, experiments on viruses, attempts to develop a chimeric virus and efforts to genetically manipulate the full-length bat SARSr-CoV WIV1 strain molecular clone. HHS records show the State Department and NIAID knew immediately in January 2020 that China was withholding COVID data [==], which was hindering risk assessment and response by public health officials. University of Texas Medical Branch (UTMB) records [=] show the former director of the Galveston National Laboratory at the University of Texas Medical Branch (UTMB), Dr. James W. Le Duc, [] warned Chinese researchers at the Wuhan Institute of Virology of potential investigations into the COVID issue by Congress. HHS records regarding biodistribution studies and related data for the COVID-19 vaccines show a key component of the vaccines developed by Pfizer/BioNTech, lipid nanoparticles (LNPs), were found outside the injection site [], mainly the liver, adrenal glands, spleen and ovaries of test animals, eight to 48 hours after injection. Records from the Federal Select Agent Program (FSAP) reveal safety lapses [==] and violations at U.S. biosafety laboratories that conduct research on dangerous agents and toxins. HHS records include emails [==] between National Institutes of Health (NIH) then-Director Francis Collins [] and Anthony Fauci, the director of National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID), about hydroxychloroquine and COVID-19. HHS records show that NIH officials tailored confidentiality forms [] to China’s terms and that the World Health Organization (WHO) conducted an unreleased, “strictly confidential” COVID-19 epidemiological analysis in January 2020. Fauci emails [=] include his approval of a press release supportive of China’s response to the 2019 novel coronavirus. DELAWARE SUPREME COURT KILLS VOTE-BY-MAIL, SAME-DAY VOTER REGISTRATION We can claim a victory for cleaner elections in Delaware. The Delaware Supreme Court struck down [==] the state’s vote-by-mail and same-day voter registration statutes for violating the Delaware Constitution. The court effectively concurs with the amicus curiae [=] brief we submitted in the case, which argues the Delaware statute impermissibly expands those practices far beyond the limits set in the Delaware Constitution. The DATE decision [==] comes in the case Albence v Higgin et al. (DE Vote by Mail 342,2022), in which the court considered the constitutionality of two state laws passed by the Delaware General Assembly that attempted to grant every voter the opportunity to vote by mail and register to vote up to the day of the general election. The court ruled [ The Vote-by-Mail Statute impermissibly expands the categories of absentee voters identified in Article V, Section 4A of the Delaware Constitution...The Same-Day Registration Statute conflicts with the provisions of Article V, Section 4 of the Delaware Constitution...The Court enters this abbreviated order in recognition of the impending election scheduled for November 8, 2022, and the Department of Election’s desire to mail ballots to voters by or around October 10, 2022. A more formal opinion, fully explaining the Court’s views and the reasons supporting our unanimous decision, will issue in due course. The mandate shall issue immediately. In our amicus curiae brief [=], we emphasized that mail-in voting is “highly susceptible to fraud and abuse” and told the court the statute in question is unconstitutional and should be struck down: State and federal officials have universally acknowledged [==] the existence of the threat of fraud due to mail-in voting...Voting by mail is ... problematic enough that election experts say there have been multiple elections in which no one can say with confidence which candidate was the deserved winner.” * The Delaware Constitution and precedent allow [==] absentee and mail-in voting in only the following instances: when in public service to the United States or the State of Delaware, due to illness or disability, by reason of absence while on vacation, due to religious tenets or teachings, and due to emergency declaration by the General Assembly in response to an ongoing pandemic...Without amending the Delaware Constitution, any legislative act by the General Assembly to expand absentee voting beyond these requirements is per se invalid. The court’s ruling makes it harder to unlawfully tamper with an election. We are gratified that the court agreed with our amicus brief and acted swiftly to strike down these unconstitutional election laws that created increased opportunities for fraud in the November 8 elections. RECORDS SHOW CDC OFFICIALS DISCUSSING POST-VACCINE MYOCARDITIS IN ADOLESCENTS Given reports [] of myocarditis in adolescents after Covid vaccination, it is disconcerting that our Centers for Disease Control has been less than forthcoming about what it knew and when. We uncovered 1,081 pages [] of records from the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) detailing internal discussions about myocarditis and the COVID vaccine. Other documents detail adverse “events for which a contributory effect of the vaccine could not be excluded.” We obtained the records through a FOIA lawsuit [==] against HHS (Judicial Watch v. U.S. Department of Health and Human Services [] (No. 1:22-cv-00660)) after the Food and Drug Administration (FDA), which is an agency of HHS, failed to respond to an August 30, 2021, FOIA request for: All emails sent to and from members of the Vaccines and Related Biological Products Advisory Committee regarding adverse events, deaths and/or injuries caused by investigatory vaccines for the prevention or treatment of SARS-CoV-2 and/or COVID-19 currently produced by Pfizer/BioNTech, Moderna and/or Johnson & Johnson. The Vaccines and Related Biological Products Advisory Committee (VRBPAC []) is the U.S. Government’s central advisory body, along with Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP []), advising whether to approve COVID vaccines. On May 13, 2021, senior CDC Director, Division of Birth Defects and Infant Disorders Dr. Amanda Cohn [], wrote to [=] FDA Director of the Center for Biologics Evaluation and Research (CBER) Dr. Peter Marks [=] and other officials about COVID-19 vaccines: “I have another issue to discuss as well, reports of myocarditis in adolescents. I am putting together an email, but this may come to the surface this weekend.” In a section of an FDA briefing document [==] submitted by Johnson & Johnson/Janssen to the FDA regarding trials of its COVID vaccine, J&J notes that five people experienced serious adverse events: “selected events among vaccine recipients for which a contributory effect of the vaccine could not be excluded based on FDA assessment of the clinical information provided.” These adverse events included deep vein thromboses, pulmonary embolism, transverse sinus thrombosis, seizure and hemiparesis (inability to move [==] one side of the body) occurring anywhere from three to 28 days following vaccination. In a section of the same briefing document as above, titled “Pregnancies,” the briefing document notes that of four women who became pregnant following the Janssen shot, two of the babies were lost – one due to an ectopic pregnancy and the other due to “spontaneous abortion.” In a section of the document titled “Safety Summary,” the study states: “Numerical imbalances were reported between vaccine and placebo recipients for thromboembolic events (15 versus 10) and tinnitus (6 versus 0).” It beggars belief that the Biden administration tried to hide these key documents that would serve to inform the public about the safety of the COVID vaccines. name: Ken Burns
subject: We are on the cusp of a momentous point in history.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
Challenges to our republic are rampant, the democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation under assault and at risk of unraveling.
#

I've spent more than four decades making films that tell America’s stories, and examining the crises – internal and external – that we have faced as a nation.
From the Civil War to the Great Depression, from the First and Second World Wars to the COVID-19 pandemic, these crises have challenged us to live up to the essential promise of our nation, preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
Challenges to our republic are rampant, the democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
We’re on the cusp of a momentous point in history. This November’s election is our chance to fortify our democracy and Constitutional rights by electing leaders who understand our history and envision a better and brighter future for us all.
We must expand our Senate majority, and one of our best chances to do that is to elect a true trailblazer in North Carolina: Cheri Beasley.
She’s already been a history maker as the first Black woman to serve as Chief Justice of the North Carolina Supreme Court, where she proved to be a relentless fighter for justice and the people of North Carolina.
Now we have the chance to elect her as North Carolina’s first Black Senator and only the third Black woman to ever serve in the U.S. Senate.
But history doesn’t happen by itself. We each have a role to play, so I am personally asking you:

body:
this race is going to be close, and we’re going to be fighting for every last vote until the last possible second.

name: Jamaal Bowman
subject: Rappers are the journalists of their communities
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Rap is expression, it is literature, it is poetry. But at its core is
freedom of speech. Rappers are the journalists of their communities —
taking on the role of storytellers to illustrate the truths of their
lives, culture, struggles, and triumphs.

For decades, freedom of speech has been the backbone of forms of art and
cultural expression. But we’ve recently ushered in a new era where that
creative expression can now be interpreted, analyzed, and used against you
in court as an artist.

That’s why I am proud to be partnering with Rep. Hank Johnson in
introducing the Restoring Artistic Protection (RAP) Act which is designed
to prevent prosecutors from using rappers' lyrics and artistic expression
as evidence in civil and criminal cases.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/118811?t=1002&akid=25694%2E1203867%2EPzCcZ1 ]Peter, it takes
all of us to call for change and protect our right to freedom of speech.
Please help us amplify our call by adding your name in support of the RAP
Act today.

Add your name ››

Since 2020, prosecutors in over 500 criminal cases have used artists’
lyrics as evidence against the artist in court and the subject of these
cases have been primarily Black and Latino men and boys.

Singers and songwriters have historically been prosecuted for their art
and all too often, systemic racism plays a large part in these
prosecutions as white artists do not face the same legal scrutiny as Black
artists. From lyrics and music videos to social media posts — all of these
facets have been used against major artists in attempts to rack up
evidence against them in the legal system.

Young Thug, Olutosin Oduwole, and many other established Black rappers
have found themselves in court having to battle against their own art to
protect their freedom. While other white artists, like Freddie Mercury,
have gone without legal trouble, even after publicly singing about
violence and murder.

This is clearly a legal tactic, and a part of an ongoing effort to
criminalize Black art. We need a national standard to protect the
legitimacy and legal safety of these artists.

Peter, it’s
time we set the standard and protect artists across the country and our
collective freedom of speech and expression. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/118811?t=1003&akid=25694%2E1203867%2EPzCcZ1 ]Please stand with us today
and add your name in support of the RAP Act today.

Peace, love, and Wu-Tang forever.

Jamaal Bowman

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1004&akid=25694%2E1203867%2EPzCcZ1 ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1005&akid=25694%2E1203867%2EPzCcZ1 ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20221023-25694-footer&t=1006&refcode2=25694_1203867_PzCcZ1&akid=25694%2E1203867%2EPzCcZ1

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://go.justicedemocrats.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1007&akid=25694%2E1203867%2EPzCcZ1

Mike Lee

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

My two opponents are fighting over which political party should represent Oregon. I am fighting for you – and for the state I love. I’m not running as an R or a D – I am running simply as an Oregonian. To finish this campaign strong, I need your help today. I don’t have dump trucks of money arriving from Washington, D.C. each day. I am relying on Oregonians like you to fund my campaign. Can you help me today? | "PLEASE DONATE TODAY" You don’t have to leave any party or join any party to support me – you only have to want a better Oregon. I don’t care if you voted for Biden or Trump or wrote in your dog, I want your vote and I need your vote to deliver big, bold change. Sincerely, Betsy "DONATE TODAY" * Paid for by Run Betsy Run The Betsy Brigade needs you to recapture Oregon’s independent spirit. subject: We need to win Wisconsin to defend the Democratic majority in the Senate
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Seth Moulton for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-barnes?refcode=221023 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-barnes?refcode=221023]

Friend,

I'm reaching out to respectfully ask if you can split $25 between my campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin and Seth Moulton. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-barnes?refcode=221023]
Here's why:
Wisconsin's Senate seat is one of the most likely to flip in 2022. And I'm relying on an unprecedented grassroots movement in order to defeat Ron Johnson.
I simply cannot do this alone.
At the very start of this campaign, I made the big decision to reject all corporate PAC money. It was a risk I was willing to take because I trusted that people like you would come together in large numbers to help flip Wisconsin's Senate seat.
This race is too important for us to come up short. So I am asking you directly:
Can I count on you to split a contribution of $25 or more between my campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin and Seth Moulton? It would mean a lot if you could chip in today. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-barnes?refcode=221023]
I've been traveling all across the state of Wisconsin, hearing directly from people who are understandably frustrated with candidates like Ron Johnson who got elected only to serve himself.
Since he's been in office, Ron Johnson has doubled his wealth as a result of the tax breaks that the Republican Party passed under Trump. And he even went so far as to complain that his wealth has only doubled – not quadrupled – during his time in Washington.
But that's not all. News recently broke that Ron Johnson tried to rig the election for Donald Trump by giving a slate of fake electors to Mike Pence on January 6th.
Then he celebrated Roe being overturned.
Enough is enough.
I am running for U.S. Senate to fight for middle class families, and to deliver opportunity for everyone. I’ll vote to abolish the filibuster and defend abortion rights, address the climate crisis, and rebuild the middle class.
But in order for that to happen, my campaign needs to stay on top of meeting our fundraising goals.
Because the truth is that we won't have the resources we need to win this race if we don't reach our fundraising goals.
As of right now, we're just a bit short of where we need to be before midnight tonight.
Can you add your contribution today?
Please split a $25 contribution between my campaign and Seth Moulton before midnight tonight. We'll put your donation immediately to work to defeat Ron Johnson. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-barnes?refcode=221023]
Thank you in advance for contributing today. It means a lot to know I can count on your support when it matters most.
All my best,

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

body:
[1]Charles Booker

Hi, it’s Charles Booker. Here’s what you should know about me:

I’m a lifelong resident of Louisville’s West End, growing up in what has
been one of the poorest zip codes in Kentucky.

Growing up, I experienced the pain of poverty firsthand and saw my mom
skip meals just so I could have enough. I’ve been homeless, and have had
to ration my insulin because I couldn’t afford the medication I needed as
a Type 1 diabetic.

I became the first in my family to graduate from law school and went on to
lead a transformative career across Kentucky, covering every level of
government. I’ve served as a Director of Fish and Wildlife, where I
traveled across the commonwealth and saw that all Kentuckians are united
in their hopes for a better future.

In 2018, I was elected to the Kentucky House of Representatives, becoming
the youngest Black state legislator in nearly 90 years.

As a legislator, I’ve fought for the people: common sense gun safety
reform, lower prescription drug prices, expanded voting rights, stronger
labor unions, and for racial justice. I’m a lifelong advocate for local
businesses and working people.

Two years ago, I founded Hood to the Holler, a grassroots organization to
build on the values that have animated my whole life and break down
barriers between Kentuckians and their government.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18782?t=1001&akid=2648%2E346206%2EBvv0J- ]Now, I’m running for U.S. Senate to continue the work of making
Kentucky a place where all of us can thrive. Will you help me win by
donating $20 or more to my campaign?

CHIP IN →

Our campaign for a better Kentucky is built by grassroots supporters like
you. I can’t thank you enough for being in the fight with me.

Charles Booker

**"Be kind and have good manners."**
That's the philosophy that Trudy lives by, Peter. It's how she raised her kids. It's how she's running this campaign. And, when we win in November, it's how she's going to serve Missouri in the Senate. **But if our opponent, Eric Schmitt, makes it to Washington, he's just going to be another extremist with no manners and not an ounce of kindness.**
So many of the problems that our country faces stem from how divided we are. And it's no mystery why we find ourselves increasingly at odds with our neighbors, friends, and family.
**Our leaders are supposed to bring us together; to encourage kindness, respect, and open, honest discussion. But instead, extremist hacks like Eric Schmitt dedicate their careers to sowing division and reaping the political benefits.**
Eric Schmitt isn't in this because he wants to make life better for Missourians. He in it to better himself – even if that means selling out family farms to Chinese companies, turning his back of folks who rely on prescription drugs, and taking the right to choose away millions of Missourians.
In short, Eric Schmitt represents everything wrong with Washington – the corruption, cold political ambition, and the dangerous extremism that ignores all reason. **But I promise you, Peter, that Trudy will be different.** If there is one thing that sets this campaign apart from others, it's our genuine, full-hearted commitment to hope, kindness, and integrity.
So this fall, you have a choice to make.**Will you send more extremists to Washington who will lead with selfishness over kindness, or will you choose something better? The first step in solving the world's problems is clarity of sight, for without it, insight is impossible.

Our Lord, in Jeremiah, warned us:
_" Foolish and senseless people, who have eyes but do not see, who have ears but do not hear: Should you not fear me? Among my people are the wicked who lie in wait like men who snare birds. [1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

You’ve probably heard by now that Georgia voters turned out in record
numbers to cast their ballots in the first week of Early Vote. It’s clear
that momentum is on our side.

But we can’t afford to get complacent now. In just 2 days, our public
fundraising numbers will lock in for the last time — and we need to raise
$1 million by then to recruit more volunteers, reach out to new voters and
maintain our historic turnout. Right now, though, we haven’t reached our
goal.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/5405?refcode=sa_em_221023_B3_PriceOfCoffee_S1_T1_TA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=14634%2E1862389%2EbCHl2R ]For the price of a cup of coffee — just $5 — you can make a real
difference in our work to get millions of Georgia voters to the polls in
the final weeks of Early Vote. If you’re able, can you make a donation to
hit our $1 million donation goal now?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/5405?refcode=sa_em_221023_B3_PriceOfCoffee_S1_T1_TA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=14634%2E1862389%2EbCHl2R ]☕DONATE☕

opportunities into our businesses, and bring more safety and freedom to
our lives.

We can make generational investments in making sure Georgians have access
to education, health care, housing and a good living — without raising
taxes.

And after four years of a governor who either doesn’t care or won’t help
many of us, Stacey is ready to get the job done. Stacey is the only person
who can move us past four years of Kemp’s mismanagement.

And Derek, for
the price of a cup of coffee, you can help ensure we keep our momentum

Growing up, smart, strong, and unconventional women were discouraged. When I ran for office, the South Carolina legislature was dominated by a Good Old Boys' Club and my opponent thought women shouldn’t be in politics. People thought I was too brown, too female, too young, too conservative, too principled. I said: Too bad.

I was inspired by great women who broke barriers and defied expectations, women like Margaret Thatcher and Jeane Kirkpatrick.

That’s why I wrote this book. | | | Hi there,

I’ve long wished we lived in a time when laws were not necessary to safeguard us from inequality. But laws – and the elected officials who write them – are what determine access to the voting booth, whether someone can have a safe abortion, or how much you pay for prescription drugs.

I’m committed to electing lawmakers who believe that _everyone_ deserves a fair shot at getting ahead and staying ahead, and I have to tell you that I’m concerned by what I’m seeing in New Hampshire and Republicans’ ruthless efforts to oust Democratic Senator Maggie Hassan.

Maggie won her last election by just 1,017 votes, and Mitch McConnell and his allies are spending almost $60 million to defeat her. **[_Before I go on, can you please split a contribution between her campaign and the DSCC?_](https://go.dscc.org/go/4728?amount=5&t=4&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-FM-20221023-BarbraStreisand-StreisandSignedHassanTandem-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FM-20221023-BarbraStreisand-StreisandSignedHassanTandem-Pros-sl1&akid=7978%2E9716520%2ELt2848)**

**My opponent also made his position clear. When pressed, he said, “ _[I will not vote to codify Roe v. Wade at the federal level.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53194204/374675947/348107445?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODk4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMzM1OTA3YS0yMzUzLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FhZej5pGIu8UtKqcT_CeTJyVPnTBoeVTeDoT1fFyBn0=&emci=1cfa6821-8251-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=e335907a-2353-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=15529135)_ ” He is not even trying to hide it anymore.**

[**Please give what you can now to keep pro-choice leaders in Congress so we can hold the majority and stop this radical agenda in its tracks.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53194205/374675948/1356459027?refcode=E18988-20221023-AbortionStance-SL-AbortionReproductiveRights-RegTemplate-NA-EG&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODk4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMzM1OTA3YS0yMzUzLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FhZej5pGIu8UtKqcT_CeTJyVPnTBoeVTeDoT1fFyBn0=)

| | Derek, Last year, Senate Republicans filibustered the Freedom to Vote Act. This bill would have strengthened election security and integrity, making it easier to register and harder for dark money to find its way into our politics. The truth is, if we fail to keep the House and Senate blue next month, we’re going to face even more of this partisan obstructionism. The right to vote is fundamental, and it’s just one of many things that the election this November is about. Protecting a woman’s right to choose, bringing high-paying manufacturing jobs back to the U.S., preserving our children’s future by fighting climate change – these are just a few of the major battles that our Congress will face in the next couple of years. _“On behalf of the entire Office of Attorney General, I’d like to congratulate Investigator Tim Morley on being fittingly selected for this honorable award. Thank you for your adherence to the rule of law and devotion to the Commonwealth of Virginia.” _**– Attorney General Miyares** In 2020, Investigator Morley participated in the inter-agency investigation of 31 convenience store smash-and-grab robberies involving stolen tobacco products in coastal Virginia. In the course of his investigations, Investigator Morley identified a known retailer as one of the perpetrators behind the smash-and-grab robberies. **The hard-work and dedication exhibited by Investigator Morley directly resulted in the enforcement of over 170 warrants, the arrest of three suspects, and the resolution of 17 separate burglary cases.**

name: Reclaiming American Freedom
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=1c1c92beeafc4830bc1aecf0d46cfcc7&_e=etxmKvsxCMQdOOf04GuE6JdwflSVFSoErHiGFx1SHFgL1RluyJ-vfSYe6RVoSnSmAdbtidBtmDcsAVanuqD-QTqQ31NvipXlNO4aZPLirpDOBEwG6FcbUQQt6lGD2hzirSpwAoNPPnLC64rxBrM2CkHf8XRSHSpsuYlFHQ0TsbqCghGNLm7cCkvFZoWjxLhd_euyST8ISmM78F9aG7n8dhvNFNkgy_JMlepaaXMGJFVfIMAfEtXrQsET-F1EbKfLk-J1WVobbqFnZ0q7rXNUqAKN9uoKPgbIlyzbzCy8dEUBZ7Ub_EnHWd8f1hXoBP0nLYVeE_4PRvbg0WHQzA6My7jSdbvBoTF7zPmfJn-J_G8Shr6jvN9ZUTB6exl2cD8Cj2CcJS6B7UO2hLqSmiVT8w%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=1c1c92beeafc4830bc1aecf0d46cfcc7&_e=etxmKvsxCMQdOOf04GuE6JdwflSVFSoErHiGFx1SHFgL1RluyJ-vfSYe6RVoSnSmAdbtidBtmDcsAVanuqD-QTqQ31NvipXlNO4aZPLirpDOBEwG6FcbUQQt6lGD2hzirSpwAoNPPnLC64rxBrM2CkHf8XRSHSpsuYlFHQ0TsbqCghGNLm7cCkvFZoWjxLhd_euyST8ISmM78F9aG7n8dhvNFNkgy_JMlepaaXMGJFWPSc9o48v-lpLMpKsTsnnlf30NxEVgPzSVRae2HHhS2zYnTLpfJoeRM0X9_H314JT6ERXmQeUS1EDHXrLXbyHPbN6RaY9ifz2Fp678JMrqYVgQowM3F9eRb2m5unUWVVoyGNpfPC4EEaZ3o6En6lMbliU4r3dLa_0rnlrH-FLmrg%3D%3D)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=1c1c92beeafc4830bc1aecf0d46cfcc7&_e=etxmKvsxCMQdOOf04GuE6JdwflSVFSoErHiGFx1SHFgL1RluyJ-vfSYe6RVoSnSmAdbtidBtmDcsAVanuqD-QTqQ31NvipXlNO4aZPLirpDOBEwG6FcbUQQt6lGD2hzirSpwAoNPPnLC64rxBrM2CkHf8XRSHSpsuYlFHQ0TsbqCghGNLm7cCkvFZoWjxLhd_euyST8ISmM78F9aG7n8dhvNFNkgy_JMlepaaXMGJFVGFYHXFWkUGriBT6xcINJ56tFVExCLaOZrEQitf0IKrsH7jyQjvTd8Jer_oEiMioCXuJ33J6utsZzT16BKPAS5mCEbgzYHqOYYgTwhsFhCMqf8v9GlPObfqZPnyuxctqydvdoODPq3xkvF6Zvm7MN40uetPRUukjWWMKwpz_ba6g%3D%3D)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

| | | | | _**Note from Cliff: A man who needs no introduction--my President during the 2000s-- has a special request of us all.**_ [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te085ea1a-7260-45e7-a0a5-48a89cb9afc7/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _Peter_ _ - _I write to you today, not as an actor or a former (fictional) president, but as an American concerned about losing our Democratic Senate majority: Donald Trump recently held a MAGA rally in Nevada to defeat Sen. Catherine Cortez Masto (D) in the race that will decide Senate control. If Trump tips the scales in favor of his hand-picked extremist, Adam Laxalt (R)– if they defeat Sen. Cortez Masto – then Democrats will lose the Senate and Mitch McConnell will regain his iron grip on power. I refuse to sit on the sidelines and watch our country return to dark days where truth is thwarted by lies and conspiracies and where the selfish interests of deranged extremists reign supreme. That's why I need you to join me in fighting back against Trump and helping Sen. Cortez Masto protect this seat and our majority. **[I’m personally asking you: Will you split $25 between Catherine’s campaign and BlueAmp Action to combat Trump's attacks, keep Nevada blue and defend our Senate majority?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5491f966-7c2c-4717-ab1f-835c6872b6ae/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

---
| I've been an activist my entire life, Peter. I've witnessed moments where people came together by the thousands, by the millions, to usher in great progress for this nation. But I've also seen the consequences when not enough people rise to the urgency of the moment before them – and right now I can say to you with confidence that we've never faced a more urgent, a more important, midterm election. If Republicans flip the one seat they need to retake control – if they flip this seat – they will usher in an era of zero bodily autonomy for women, of further attacks on voting and free and fair elections, of turning a blind eye to climate change. They will roll out the red carpet for the return of the impeached former president. It's why Donald Trump himself flew all the way to Nevada to hold one of his infamous, dangerous MAGA rallies: to defeat Catherine Cortez Masto and begin his return to power. We must do everything we can to stop him, and that means ensuring Catherine has the resources to fight back and win. **[Please, rush $25 or whatever you can spare to fight back against Trump, help Catherine Cortez Masto win in Nevada and protect our Democratic Senate majority.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc8e330ac-7fa0-4fd5-a543-c07c450d921d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) ** Thank you, Martin Sheen

|

---
Unfortunately, this doesn't come as a surprise. Opponents of democracy spread falsehoods about and made threats against polling places and election workers in 2020, and we fully expected them to do so again.
That's exactly why we've made defending poll workers and our election infrastructure a core component of our strategy this year. **Because as A.G. Holder has said, "in order to protect democracy, we have to _do_ democracy."**
But doing this work across **17 target states** takes a _lot_ of resources. So we're counting on grassroots supporters like you to help us make sure we can put every part of our strategy into place and protect every part of our election infrastructure.
**The threats to our democracy are real, but we have a plan to fight back. So please, pitch in anything you can to help us keep up our critically important work all over the country:**

_Gabby and me during her recovery_
Friends –
When I think about the toughest times in my life, I’m thankful I’ve always had a support system to help me through.

Being raised by two working parents who sometimes struggled to make ends meet wasn’t always easy.

Flying combat missions in Desert Storm wasn’t easy.

Watching Gabby fight so hard in the early days, weeks and months of her recovery wasn’t easy.

Running for the U.S. Senate and having Donald Trump and National Republicans relentlessly attack me personally — that hasn’t been easy either.

But as a kid, I had my brother Scott.

In combat, I had my wingmen.

With Gabby, we had our whole community offering support.
And in these campaigns, I have you.

I could not do this without you, friend. You probably didn't wake up this morning thinking you’d make a donation to my campaign, but I really need you if we’re going to defeat our Republican opponent and hold this seat.

| Hi Peter, it’s Josh. I’m writing to you today from the road heading out east for some important campaign events.

Early voting is less than a week away, and the truth is that a lot of voters have yet to decide their ballot in our race for New York’s 19th Congressional District. I’m crisscrossing the district to lock down every vote that I can. [_**And if you pitch in $5 or more, it will help me reach a few more persuadable voters.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53190396/374657386/-209395415?refcode=BLU-JRFC-20221023-1-EM&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTM1OTNkZi0wYzUzLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fdp0pAy79CU859HXgdP8VC1M8-Mex7l0kBS9H3PXQN4=)

But here’s the deal — I’m not fazed because we’re in this together, and their lies and their fear-mongering can’t match the positive grassroots momentum of the team we’ve built. | | Hi Peter, We know you get _a lot_ of emails asking for your grassroots support. Jasmine's inbox is pretty much exploding with campaign emails from around the country and we know it can feel like a lot. We understand that you can’t donate to every email you receive, and we don’t expect you to. You’re not an ATM. You’re a partner in this campaign and you deserve an honest assessment of what’s happening – so we’re always going to tell you what we’re seeing on the ground and what we need to do next to execute a winning strategy. And we're going to humbly ask for your support – no matter how big or small. **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

This is why there has been a flurry of stories about the Senate race in Utah. I need your help ASAP. We cannot take anything for granted this election. Even though my opponent is a Democrat disguised as an Independent - he OUTRAISED my campaign, and we know he will use this war chest to chip away at my lead in the race. Please, Fellow American, don’t sit on the sidelines during this critical time. For America, Mike Lee MEET MIKE: | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property. After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court. Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah. | | | ---|---|--- | Paid for by Friends of Mike Lee, Inc. PO Box 1537 Salt Lake City, UT 84110

body:
The midterms are 16 days away. I hope you’ll chip in to the DNC today to help defeat MAGA Republicans and elect Democrats nationwide. | |
---
Derek, we’re 16 days from the midterms -- and the stakes are crystal clear. It’s about the right to choose. It’s about the right to privacy. It’s about whether Social Security will be paid for or whether it’s going to be something that comes up every year and has to be voted on again. It’s about the safety of kids -- instead of dealing with reading and writing and arithmetic, learning how to duck and cover. It’s about the survival of the planet -- literally, not figuratively. It’s about the right to vote. It’s really about democracy itself. And I don’t think that’s hyperbole. **America is at an inflection point: MAGA Republicans are going to take us backward. And we have to choose a different path. I am writing today to humbly ask if you can split a $25 contribution between my campaign and CommonGood to help flip Wisconsin's Senate seat and expand the Democratic majority. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20221023_CGVA_Barnes]

body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Hello Derek,

We’ve built one of the most robust grassroots teams in Georgia history and
I’m so thankful you are a part of it. In just the first days of Early
Vote, more than 570,000 voters have turned out to the polls to make their
voices heard.

These are historic numbers,
Derek.

Our campaign is well on the way to defeating Brian Kemp’s dangerous agenda
and beginning to build One Georgia where everyone thrives. But first, we
have to win. And I am counting on
supporters like you
to make it possible.

We have outraised an incumbent governor multiple times in the last few
months, but we have to outwork him every single day if we are going to
win. In just 2 days, on October 25, our last public fundraising numbers
will lock in — and we need to raise $1 million by then to overcome Kemp’s
offensive and win this race.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221023_B4_GrassrootsSupport_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=14636%2E1862389%2E3HlZyN ]Help me hold Brian Kemp accountable at the ballot box and create a
state where all can thrive. Any amount you’re able to give today — no
matter how big or small — makes a real difference in raising $1 million
before our public fundraising report deadline.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221023_B4_GrassrootsSupport_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=14636%2E1862389%2E3HlZyN ]DONATE

With less than 16 days left until Election Day, I am proud of the strength
of this grassroots team of
supporters. I am
counting on you to power our work every step of the way, and I know you’ve
got my back in this final stretch. If we raise $1 million before Tuesday’s
deadline, we will signal to Brian Kemp that voters are rejecting his
extreme agenda.

Together, we have the power to change lives, invest in every Georgian and
build One Georgia, where all can thrive and succeed.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221023_B4_GrassrootsSupport_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=14636%2E1862389%2E3HlZyN ]So much is on the line if we’re going to create a state where
education, health care, housing and a good living are possible for all.
Can you help hit our $1 million goal before October 25? With your
continued support we can win and get to work for Georgians.

Derek, I’m so
grateful you’re a part of this team,

Stacey Abrams

Folks – I know what running in a tight race feels like because I’ve done it before. In fact, my last race – which I won by just 1,017 votes – was one of the tightest Senate races in history.
Now, I am running for reelection against Don Bolduc, an extreme, right-wing, election denier, and **[I need your help because I can tell you, without a doubt, that this race to defeat him is going to be *really* close.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53191597/374664275/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1908-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YzQ1Y2M3NC0xMTUzLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DeyUnaNfLSrveK5a7iB2_8ItTpf66nJ8lUcdUVZjvG8=)**
But you don’t have to take my word for it – just ask the Republicans doing everything in their power to flip this seat. **We can tell what the GOP thinks about this race because of the amount of money they are investing in it.**
I use the word “investing” intentionally. The GOP is pouring tens of millions into the Granite State because they believe they will receive a huge return on their investment: **retaking control of the U.S. Senate.**
They see the path to winning this race, taking back this seat, and planting Mitch McConnell firmly in the Majority leader’s office. Now they are spending $55 million to make it happen.
They are trying to buy this seat out from under us because they know what we know: the current political environment is one of the toughest that Democrats have seen in years.
**But for 16 more days, we still have the power to fight back, folks. **We can prove Don Bolduc, Mitch McConnell, and their dark money allies wrong and keep this seat, but only if we pull together.

From 2015-2021 while I was living abroad, I watched so much happen in America that was difficult to bear. I watched a division I had never seen before. I was living in Northern Ireland and saw America begin to accept violence as a form of political speech in a way I have seen nowhere in my life other than in Belfast. I watched January 6th and wept for my country. It was a tough time to be away.

Based on my experiences, when I got the opportunity to work for Jeff, I jumped at it. When these times are written about in history books (and they will be), I want to know I did everything in my power to make a difference. Jeff decided to run because he too wants to make a difference. I believe you too will work toward this common goal. We are counting on you to join the effort. In fact, we can’t do it without you.

In these final two weeks, we need people to step up, knock on doors, and make phone calls. We have to reach out to every person who told us they would vote for Jeff and every supporter who isn’t a reliable voter to remind them of the importance of the election on November 8th. Every vote matters, and without your help, we will not reach the numbers we need.
I’ll be real with you, the early vote numbers look promising. Our polling looks promising. Our candidate is incredible. But none of that will matter if we don’t get our voters out to the polls. Talking to a voter on their door with our script increases the likelihood that they turnout out to vote between 4-8%. Talking to them on the phone increases the likelihood they will vote by 2%. Our race will be very close, and volunteers like you will make all the difference. Can I count on you to help us get out the vote in the final two weeks?

name: Pete Maysmith, LCV Victory Fund
subject: URGENT: Four must-win House races in jeopardy. We have to act NOW before it's too late.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by LCV Victory Fund, www
body:
Triple your impact: keep pro-polluters out of Congress. |
---

| [3X MATCH ACTIVE: We need to keep the environmental majority in the House >>](https://links.messages.lcv.)
We're really down to the wire, Peter -- and virtually every analysis is saying the same thing: if the election were held today, **we would lose an environmental majority in the House.**

**We can 't let that happen -- and we need your help.** Our mobilization efforts are operating full steam ahead: we're getting mailers in voters' mailboxes and running digital ads in **_dozens_** of House races across the country. We're working to turn out voters in districts where **environmental champions are in serious toss-ups against their opponents:**
* In Iowa's 3rd, Rep. Cindy Axne, who has scaled up Iowa's clean energy efforts, _is polling less than half a point behind._
* In Kansas's 3rd, Rep. Sharice Davids, who has consistently voted for climate action and public lands protections, _is tracking just one point ahead._
* In Pennsylvania's 7th, Rep. Susan Wild, a co-chair of the New Democrat Coalition's Climate Change Task Force, is _less than half a point ahead._
* And, in Virginia's 2nd, Rep. Elaine Luria, a sponsor of several public lands and wildlife preservation bills, is _now polling 50/50 against her opponent._

**These are all races where environmental leaders in Congress have a real chance to defeat pro-polluter, MAGA candidates.** We can't give up on a single winnable House race -- without an environmental majority in the House of Representatives, our ability to make progress on issues like climate change, environmental justice, and voting rights will all but disappear.

We are working hard to mobilize enough voters to make a difference in these races, but the _only_ way we're going to keep our momentum going is with your help. And a group of donors is **triple matching every contribution right now** to help elect as many environmental candidates as possible this November.
[We can't afford to lose our environmental majority in Congress: Please, pitch in today to help House climate champions win their races. Even $5 is enough to make a difference >>](https://links.messages.lcv.)
Right now, LCV Victory Fund is running a massive mobilization effort to engage and motivate climate voters in this critical election. Here's more on what we've been doing to turn out climate voters up and down the ballot:

Here's where our GOTV campaign stands right now:
* **Strategically focusing resources** in close races, where our efforts can make a real difference to the outcomes.
* **Identifying voters and messages** through research to reach _millions_ of voters in battleground states.
* **Engaging early and aggressively** with TV and digital ads to define candidates for voters.
* **Motivating and mobilizing voters** through canvassing and providing voters with information about how to vote in their states, including early voting and vote by mail.
* **Supporting the work of our 30+ state affiliates** who are making an impact on governors, state legislative, and other local races across the country.
* **Expanding partnerships** with other progressive groups to help elect pro-environment and pro-democracy candidates.

[TRIPLE YOUR IMPACT: We're down to the final few weeks,Peter. Please, help us turn out every last climate voter in this election!](https://links.messages.lcv.)

Keeping a pro-environment majority in Congress is important for our communities, our planet, and future generations. That's why your support is an integral piece of winning this fight, not just in November, but for the long term.

Thank you for being part of our work to elect climate leaders who will build a better future for all.

Onward,

Pete Maysmith
Senior VP of Campaigns
LCV Victory Fund

I don't want to scare you, team, but I have to tell you this.
Even if Democrats are able to hang on to the U.S. Senate and House next month, it may not be enough to save democracy – not if Republicans win state-level offices that give them control over elections.
**"How Six States Could Overturn the 2024 Election"**
_The Atlantic_
---
As important as it is to win federal races, gubernatorial races in states like Nevada, Georgia, and Wisconsin might be even more important to our future.
The NDRC gets it – that's why we've endorsed 13 candidates for governor, five for secretary of state, and literally hundreds for state legislature. **[But it's impossible to support all of those Democracy Defenders without _every single person_ reading this pitching in.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/53193449/374673011/-2030895994?amount=30&refcode=20221024.2r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM2MDQxNDBjLTFlNTMtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGUwOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ds7ESn2koQviSxIbI65guq8fWCwKJm6T8Qph3vf_lqo=)**

Recently, our Republican Governor said in an interview that he is "not sure what more we could do" to protect women and abortion rights. **** I do know what more we could do. As Governor I will: 1\. Take necessary steps to make Vermont a safe haven for all who are here and all who come here to seek abortion for any reason. 2\. Create a Shield law to protect reproductive and gender-affirming care providers and anyone who supports them from investigation and medical license penalties for charges from other states. 3\. Change Vermont's extradition laws in order to protect doctors, anyone who supports someone accessing abortion or those who come here to exercise reproductive liberty, marriage equality or gender-affirming care. 4\. Increase funding for reproductive health and support funds to ensure that those who come here to access abortion will not end up with this service publicly available to their state. 5\. Update Vermont's fair and impartial policing policy to bar Vermont law enforcement and any state agencies from cooperating with out-of-state investigations into reproductive health care, marriage equality, or gender-affirming care. 6\. Codify access to contraception through an equal rights amendment to our Vermont constitution as well as LGBTQIA rights and marriage equality. 7\. Plan and prepare for intrastate refugees to Vermont. 8\. Build a coalition with neighboring states to look at and implement a plan to protect Vermonters and our fellow Americans in the event of a federal ban that has already been introduced by Republicans. 9\. Pass and sign mandatory paid family and medical leave for those who do carry a pregnancy to term. 10\. Codify all forms of reproductive liberty into law so that there is no question that it is solely the choice of the person as to when, or if, they choose to become parents. I won’t back down from this moment. We need proactive leadership. We need a leader who is ready to lead. Friend, Georgia is currently grappling with the pending closure of Wellstar Atlanta Medical Center. This is the result of backward Republican policies (such as failing to expand Medicaid), and it's a reminder that we need to hold anti-healthcare politicians accountable this coming Election Day.

| | Friends, “the Election” is on November 8. But voting is happening now. Each day thousands of ballots are being turned in — _**and thousands more ballots are being forgotten under piles of mail.**_ I’ve worked in politics a long time, and I can’t begin to count the number of people who have told me they just _forgot_ to vote. Truly! And they would have voted for the Democrats if they’d been reminded a) that there was an election, and b) what was at stake. **We have got to execute a massive get out the vote program if we want to protect our Democratic House Majority, democracy, and basic civil rights.** **[Friend, can you pitch in $5 right now to Dr. Kermit Jones’ campaign before his end-of-month fundraising deadline? I’m aiming to take down 30-year career politician Patty Murray, and my race is shaping up to be the biggest upset in our nation’s history. So I’ll cut to the chase. We’re nearing the end of an uphill battle. Our team is climbing in the polls and causing the Democrats to panic. I’m gearing up to have the upset of the century, My husband and I are raising our boys to be honest men of their word, so I can assure you I’ll keep my promise to restore our values in the Senate. Thank you for your time and God bless, Tiffany Smiley Republican Candidate for U.S. Senate | | | Growing up, smart, strong, and unconventional women were discouraged. clean_body: | | | | Harriet has been working hard to help fellow conservatives get elected in Wyoming and across the country this November. She continues traveling across Wyoming meeting with voters, touring businesses, and learning about Wyoming’s industries. The primary election is just 15 days away! Check Harriet’s upcoming schedule below and help spread the word! For Wyoming, Team Hageman On the road! Harriet has supported various candidates to ensure the election of a conservative majority at both the state and national level -- to take our country back! Harriet has campaigned in support of Tomi Strock in Douglas, Scott Smith in Torrington, and Jeremy Haroldson in Wheatland. If you or anyone you know lives in these areas be sure to get out to vote for these great conservatives! Harriet attended events in support of candidates Bo Hines in North Carolina’s 13th district, Zach Nunn in Iowa’s 3rd district, and Eli Crane in Arizona’s 2nd district. All seats are key to a conservative majority in the U.S. House. Congressman Jason Smith of Missouri, State Representative John Bear, and State Representative Chip Neiman joined Harriet for a tour of the Belle Ayr mine in Gillette. They spent time with Eagle Specialty Materials employees to learn more about the industry and the challenges they face. Voter Contact! There are only 2 Saturdays until the general election!
